title: (RHBA-2018:2269) Fuse 7.0.1 images
portal_summary:
This update for the Red Hat Fuse 7.0.1 release of 'Fuse on OpenShift' and 'Fuse Online (Ignite)' images addresses the following Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) issues:
https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/CVE-2018-12020
https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/CVE-2016-2183
https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/CVE-2018-1085
https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/CVE-2018-10843
https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/CVE-2018-1070
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.9|x86_64
portal_solution:
This release consists of the following parts:
* Fuse on OpenShift images (provided through the Red Hat container catalog)
* Fuse Online (Ignite) images (provided through the Red Hat container catalog)
* Updated Maven dependencies (provided through the Red Hat Maven repository)

These images are intended for use with the following components:
* Red Hat Fuse version: 7.0.1.fuse-000008-redhat-3
* Maven archetype version: 2.2.0.fuse-000110-redhat-4

To update your Maven POM file for the old-style BOM:
* Fabric8 BOM version: 3.0.11.fuse-000065-redhat-3
* Fabric8 Maven plug-in version: 3.5.33.fuse-000089-redhat-4
* Wildfly Camel BOM version: 5.1.0.fuse-000083-redhat-3

To update your Maven POM file for the new-style BOM:
* redhat-fuse BOM Version: 7.0.1.fuse-000008-redhat-4

Update your Fuse on OpenShift / Fuse Online deployments to use the updated images and update the BOM version and Fabric8 Maven plug-in version in your Maven project file (pom.xml). For details on how to apply this update, see the patching instructions in "Fuse on OpenShift Guide" https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_fuse/7.0/html-single/fuse_on_openshift_guide/#patching
